institution.name: SMK – Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1916. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1916 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: A small, loosely painted study of two tall white candles, both lit, in plain metal candlesticks on a white tablecloth, against a dark brown background.
alt.zh: 一幅笔触松快的小习作：两支点着的白色长蜡烛插在朴素的金属烛台上，立在白桌布上，背景是深褐色。

note.en: A quick study rather than a finished painting: two candles, a cloth and a dark wall in a few brown and grey strokes. Hammershøi spent his life on very few things, rooms, light and a handful of objects, and this is the shortest statement of them. Two lights on one table: very nearly the emblem of this library.
note.zh: 这是一幅速写式的习作，不是完成的画：两支蜡烛、一块桌布、一面暗墙，几笔褐与灰。哈默修伊一生只画很少的东西——房间、光、几件器物——这是其中最简短的一句。一张桌上两点光：几乎就是这座图书馆的标志。
